about: Inkling-2-Mini (GGUF · UD-IQ4_XS, F16 mmproj vision, q8_0 KV) at a 344,064-token context on one RTX 3090 24GB: unsloth's llama.cpp release b12588-mix-c0c3de8 plus the hc19 patch (fused Inkling CUDA kernels; banded flash attention reading q8_0 K/V in-kernel; no f16 K/V scratch reserved for it). Single slot.
setup: BUILD: extract the pinned unsloth source tarball into llama.cpp-inkling2-hc19/, apply docs/rtx3090-inkling-2-mini-llamacpp-hc19/inkling2-hc19.patch (git apply), then cmake -B build -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build --target llama-server (docs/rtx3090-inkling-2-mini-llamacpp-hc19/build.sh does all of it and checks the tarball sha256). Measured with CUDA 13.4, driver 615.78. NEEDS: the whole 24 GB card; peak device memory was ~24.1 GB at a 330K-token prompt including ~1.25 GB held by a desktop, so a headless card has ~1 GB more headroom. One slot only: with --parallel > 1 a long concurrent prefill takes llama.cpp's dense attention path, which copies the q8_0 cache to f16 and runs out of memory.
